add_canonical_header.description: Indicates whether the Canonical header is added to the responses.

allow_referers.description: The list of referrer hostnames that are allowed to access the pull zone. Requests containing the header "Referer: hostname" that is not on the list will be rejected. If empty, all the referrers are allowed.

block_ips.description: The list of IPs that are blocked from accessing the pull zone. Requests coming from the following IPs will be rejected. If empty, all the IPs will be allowed

block_no_referer.description: Indicates whether requests without a referer should be blocked.

block_post_requests.description: Indicates whether to block POST requests.

block_referers.description: The list of referrer hostnames that are blocked to access the pull zone. Requests containing the header "Referer: hostname" that is not on the list will be rejected. If empty, all the referrers are allowed.

block_root_path.description: This property indicates whether to block the root path.

cache_chunked.description: Indicates whether the cache slice (Optimize for large object delivery) feature is enabled for the Pull Zone

cache_enabled.description: Indicates whether smart caching is enabled.

cache_errors.description: Indicates whether bunny.net should be caching error responses.

cache_expiration_time.description: The override cache time, in seconds.

cache_expiration_time_browser.description: The override cache time for the end client, in seconds.

cache_vary_cookie.description: Contains the list of vary parameters that will be used for vary cache by cookie string. If empty, cookie vary will not be used.

cache_vary_querystring.description: Contains the list of vary parameters that will be used for vary cache by query string. If empty, all parameters will be used to construct the key

cdn_domain.description: The CNAME domain of the pull zone for setting up custom hostnames

cors_enabled.description: Indicates whether CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is enabled.

cors_extensions.description: A list of file extensions for which CORS is enabled.

disable_letsencrypt.description: If true, the built-in let's encrypt is disabled and requests are passed to the origin.

errorpage_custom_content.description: Contains the custom error page code that will be returned.

errorpage_custom_enabled.description: Indicates whether custom error page code should be enabled.

errorpage_statuspage_code.description: The statuspage code that will be used to build the status widget.

errorpage_statuspage_enabled.description: Indicates whether the statuspage widget should be displayed on the error pages.

errorpage_whitelabel.description: Indicates whether the error pages should be white-labelled or not

id.description: The unique ID of the pull zone.

limit_after.description: The amount of data after the rate limit will be activated.

limit_bandwidth.description: The maximum bandwidth limit in bytes.

limit_burst.description: Excessive requests are delayed until their number exceeds the maximum burst size.

limit_connections.description: The number of connections limited per IP.

limit_download_speed.description: The maximum download speed, in kb/s. Use 0 for unlimited.

limit_requests.description: The maximum amount of requests per IP per second.

log_forward_enabled.description: Indicates whether log forwarding is enabled.

log_forward_port.description: The port number for log forwarding.

log_forward_server.description: The server address for log forwarding.

log_forward_token.description: The token used for log forwarding authentication.

log_storage_enabled.description: Indicates whether log storage is enabled.

log_storage_zone.description: The storage zone ID for log storage.

name.description: The name of the pull zone.

optimizer_burrow.description: Indicates whether Burrow Smart Routing should be enabled.

optimizer_classes_force.description: Indicates whether the optimizer class list should be enforced.

optimizer_dynamic_image_api.description: Indicates whether the image manipulation should be enabled.

optimizer_enabled.description: Indicates whether Bunny Optimizer should be enabled.

optimizer_html_prerender.description: Indicates whether HTML Prerender should be enabled.

optimizer_minify_css.description: Indicates whether the CSS minification should be enabled.

optimizer_minify_js.description: Indicates whether the JavaScript minification should be enabled.

optimizer_smartimage.description: Indicates whether the automatic image optimization should be enabled.

optimizer_smartimage_desktop_maxwidth.description: The maximum automatic image size for desktop clients.

optimizer_smartimage_desktop_quality.description: The image quality for desktop clients.

optimizer_smartimage_mobile_maxwidth.description: The maximum automatic image size for mobile clients.

optimizer_smartimage_mobile_quality.description: Determines the image quality for mobile clients

optimizer_watermark.description: Indicates whether image watermarking should be enabled.

optimizer_watermark_borderoffset.description: The offset of the watermark image.

optimizer_watermark_minsize.description: The minimum image size to which the watermark will be added.

optimizer_watermark_url.description: The URL of the watermark image.

optimizer_webp.description: Indicates whether the WebP optimization should be enabled.

originshield_concurrency_limit.description: Indicates whether there is a concurrency limit for Origin Shield.

originshield_concurrency_requests.description: The number of concurrent requests for Origin Shield.

originshield_enabled.description: Indicates whether Origin Shield is enabled.

originshield_queue_requests.description: The number of queued requests for Origin Shield.

originshield_queue_wait.description: The maximum wait time for queued requests in Origin Shield, in seconds.

permacache_storagezone.description: The storage zone ID for Perma-Cache.

request_coalescing_enabled.description: Indicates whether request coalescing is enabled.

request_coalescing_timeout.description: Specifies the timeout period, in seconds, for request coalescing, determining how long to wait before sending combined requests to the origin.

s3_auth_enabled.description: Indicates whether requests to origin will be signed with AWS Signature Version 4.

s3_auth_key.description: The access key used to authenticate the requests.

s3_auth_region.description: The region name of the bucket used to authenticate the requests.

s3_auth_secret.description: The secret key used to authenticate the requests.

safehop_connection_timeout.description: The amount of seconds to wait when connecting to the origin. Otherwise the request will fail or retry.

safehop_response_timeout.description: The amount of seconds to wait when waiting for the origin reply. Otherwise the request will fail or retry.

safehop_retry_count.description: The number of retries to the origin server.

safehop_retry_delay.description: The amount of time that the CDN should wait before retrying an origin request.

sort_querystring.description: If enabled, the query parameters will be automatically sorted into a consistent order before checking the cache.

strip_cookies.description: If enabled, bunny.net will strip all the Set-Cookie headers from the HTTP responses.

token_auth_enabled.description: Indicates whether requests without a valid token and expiry timestamp will be rejected.

token_auth_ip_validation.description: Indicates whether the secure hash generated by the server will also include an IP address.

token_auth_key.description: The auth key used for secure URL token authentication.

use_background_update.description: Indicates whether cache update is performed in the background.

websockets_enabled.description: Indicates whether the WebSocket support is enabled.

websockets_max_connections.description: The maximum allowed concurrent WebSocket connections.

container_app_id.description: The ID if the compute container app.

container_endpoint_id.description: The ID if the compute container app endpoint.

dns_port.description: The port for DNS Accelerated endpoints.

dns_scheme.description: The scheme for DNS Accelerated endpoints.

follow_redirects.description: Indicates whether the zone will follow origin redirects.

forward_host_header.description: Indicates whether the current hostname is forwarded to the origin.

host_header.description: The host header that will be sent to the origin.

middleware_script.description: The ID of the compute script used as a middleware.

script.description: The ID of the linked compute script.

storagezone.description: The ID of the linked storage zone.

url.description: The origin URL from where the files are fetched.

verify_ssl.description: Indicates whether the Origin's TLS certificate should be verified.

blocked_countries.description: The list of blocked countries with the two-letter Alpha2 ISO codes. Traffic connecting from a blocked country will be rejected on the DNS level.

redirected_countries.description: The list of budget redirected countries with the two-letter Alpha2 ISO codes. Traffic from a redirected country will connect to the cheapest possible node in North America or Europe.

block.description: This data source represents a bunny.net Pullzone.

custom.description: Select custom or curated Access Lists.

pullzone.description: The ID of the linked pullzone.

block.description: This resource represents an Access List for a bunny.net pullzone.

allow_latency_routing.description: Indicates whether latency routing is allowed for this region.

continent_code.description: The code representing the continent where the region is located.

country_code.description: The code representing the country where the region is located.

id.description: The unique identifier for the region.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the region.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the region.

price_per_gigabyte.description: The cost per gigabyte of data transfer in this region.

region_code.description: The code representing a specific region.

block.description: This data source provides information about the regions supported by bunny.net. It is used to retrieve a list of regions where bunny.net services are available, which can then be used to configure other resources within those specific regions.

code.description: The code of the video language.

name.description: The name of the video language.

support_player_translation.description: Indicates whether player translation is supported for this language.

support_transcribing.description: Indicates whether transcribing is supported for this language.

transcribing_accuracy.description: The accuracy of transcription for this language, represented as a percentage.

block.description: This data source provides a list of languages supported for bunny.net video streaming. It is used to retrieve and specify the languages available for video content, which can be important for configuring multi-language support in video streaming services.
